Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old spent almost three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after allegedly giving law enforcement a false name and birth date. The city took 20 days to verify he was a minor, despite being alerted to the possibility almost immediately after his arrest. During that time, he was kept apart from other inmates in a section for people with special needs. The story also reported that California law does not allow suspects under 18 to be detained in adult jails, and that a judge ordered the teenager transferred to juvenile hall on $10,000 bail.
